components.name: Copy button
components.css: .ds-copy{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;font:400 15px/1.3 var(--sans, "Source Sans 3", sans-serif);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;background:#f0f1eb;color:var(--ink, #151b24);border:1px solid #d5d9ce}.ds-copy:hover{background:#e1e7d6}.ds-copy:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #50643b); outline-offset: 4px; }.ds-copy:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;background:#e9ece4;color:#596451;border-color:#bac7b0}@media(max-width:640px){.ds-copy{min-height:44px}}

components.name: Expanded copy button
components.description: Olive copy action on the expanded entry.
components.css: .ds-copy-expanded{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;font:400 15px/1.3 var(--sans, "Source Sans 3", sans-serif);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--action, #50643b);color:white;border:1px solid var(--action, #50643b)}.ds-copy-expanded:hover{background:#3f512e}.ds-copy-expanded:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-copy-expanded:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #50643b); outline-offset: 4px; }@media(max-width:640px){.ds-copy-expanded{min-height:44px}}

components.name: Search field
components.description: Wide search field with a container focus ring.
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:46px;padding:0 14px;border:1px solid #c8ccc5;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:var(--muted, #555e65)}.ds-search svg{flex-shrink:0}.ds-search input{width:100%;min-width:0;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #151b24);padding:8px 12px;font:400 17px/1.5 var(--sans, "Source Sans 3", sans-serif)}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted, #555e65);opacity:1}.ds-search:focus-within{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #50643b);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Original prompt surface
components.description: Readable original text with whitespace preserved. Demonstration text only.
components.html: Original prompt text appears here. Line breaks remain intact.

narrative.overview:
Off-white paper, dark ink, olive actions, and serif headings give the archive its reading character. Compact sans-serif controls keep finding and copying a prompt straightforward.

The visual system is flat and restrained. Type, fine rules, and small tonal changes establish hierarchy. This document captures the implementation in `app/globals.css` and `app/library.tsx`; the selected page composition and acceptance criteria remain in `docs/prompt-journal.md`. No raster imagery ships.
keyCharacteristics: Paper background and dark, readable text.
Serif titles with sans-serif controls and monospaced original text.
Fine timeline rules and compact command labels.
Olive accents for actions, focus, and expanded entries.
dos: Do preserve the serif title, sans-serif control, and monospace content roles.
Do keep focus indicators visible against the paper and tinted surfaces.
Do preserve original text whitespace and wrap long content within its container.
Do use fine rules and tonal surfaces to establish hierarchy.
donts: Don't add elevation shadows to the existing flat journal components.
Don't turn command labels into controls without a corresponding interaction.
Don't replace original content with illustrative copy or image-based text.
